props.custom_logic_action:
// Custom Logic - Action (.custom_logic_action)

// If caster has "Flying" ActiveEffect => +10 bonus damage

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][FLYING+10]";

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD;

if (!p) return console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

// --- Resolve caster (recommended pattern) ---

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? "");

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) return console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve attackerActor");

// --- Your Flying ActiveEffect UUID (primary check) ---

const FLYING_EFFECT_UUID =

"Actor.bSQw4jzBGsfBUdmc.Item.c08xy4g0CniRcXoH.ActiveEffect.zpqT055SXRwFhP4R";

let hasFlying = false;

// 1) UUID check (only counts if the resolved ActiveEffect belongs to THIS caster)

try {

const fxDoc = await fromUuid(FLYING_EFFECT_UUID);

const fxParentActor = fxDoc?.parent?.parent ?? fxDoc?.parent; // ActiveEffect -> Item -> Actor (or -> Actor)

if (fxDoc && fxParentActor?.uuid === attackerActor.uuid) {

hasFlying = true;

}

} catch (err) {

// Ignore and fall back to name check

}

// 2) Fallback: name/label check on caster's active effects

if (!hasFlying) {

const effects = Array.from(attackerActor?.effects ?? []);

hasFlying = effects.some(e => {

const n = String(e?.name ?? e?.label ?? "").trim();

return n === "Flying";

});

}

// --- Apply bonus damage if Flying ---

if (!hasFlying) {

return console.log(TAG, "No Flying detected -> no bonus", { attacker: attackerActor.name });

}

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

const before = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = before + 10;

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED +10 bonus damage", {

attacker: attackerActor.name,

bonusBefore: before,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});

})();
